label: meaningful
label_meaning: meaningful: built from the seller's own published schema

note.description: Present only on a sample response (empty/omitted query): a hint to pass a real query. The paid request ran; no upstream call was made.

partial.description: True when one feed (volume or tone) was unavailable and its metric is null on every point — distinguishes a degraded answer from genuinely missing data

tone.description: Average article tone on this date; null if the tone feed had no value here

volume_pct.description: Share of monitored coverage matching the query on this date; null if the volume feed had no value here

warnings.description: Human-readable notes on any degraded feed, e.g. "tone feed unavailable"; empty when the answer is complete

attribution.derived_from: the schema and example output the seller publicly lists there
attribution.status: unclaimed: the owner can claim or remove the matching listing on the discovery board
